title: Rapid and sensitive detection of vanillylmandelic acid based on a luminescent fourteen-metal Tb(III) planar nanocluster

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.formula: [Tb14(L)2(L')2(OH)2(CO3)4(OAc)26(H2O)2] (L from H2L = N,N'-bis(3-methoxysalicylidene)pentane-1,3-diamine; L' from HL' = 3-methoxysalicylaldehyde); elemental formula C114H146N4O82Tb14

material_class.structural_family: centrosymmetric planar carbonate-templated Tb14 nanocluster with {Tb5(CO3)} units

synthesis.procedure: The precursor H2L was prepared in the SI by Schiff-base condensation: 3-methoxysalicylaldehyde (20 mmol, 3.0430 g) in 50 mL EtOH was treated dropwise with 1,3-diaminopentane (10 mmol, 1.0218 g) in 25 mL EtOH, stirred and heated under reflux for 5 h, cooled, filtered in vacuum, washed with EtOH (3 × 5 mL), and dried under vacuum to give a yellow solid (3.0138 g, 81.35%). For 1, at room temperature 3-methoxysalicylaldehyde (0.20 mmol, 3.043 g, as printed) and H2L (0.20 mmol, 0.074 g) were dissolved in 8 mL EtOH and 4 mL MeOH, then triethylamine in EtOH (1.0 mol/L, 1 mL) was added. Tb(OAc)3·6H2O (0.20 mmol, 0.0888 g) was added and the mixture was heated under reflux with stirring for 30 min and cooled to room temperature. The mixture was filtered to a clear solution, and slow diffusion of diethyl ether for two weeks gave yellow crystals of 1. The main text states only that 1 formed as a yellow solid from H2L, HL' and Tb(OAc)3·6H2O, and that the four CO3(2-) templates arise by fixation of CO2 from air; it gives no numerical amounts.

reagents.name: 3-methoxysalicylaldehyde
reagents.amount: 0.20 mmol, 3.043 g (as printed in SI; same mass is given for 20 mmol in the H2L preparation)

synthesis.temperature: room temperature, then reflux, then cooled to room temperature; crystallization over two weeks
synthesis.time: reflux 30 min; diethyl ether diffusion for two weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reflux with stirring, filtration, then slow diethyl ether diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered to a clear solution; slow diffusion of diethyl ether for two weeks afforded yellow crystals

properties.summary: 1 is a yellow luminescent Tb(III) cluster used as a turn-on sensor for vanillylmandelic acid (VMA). In CH3CN it shows ligand-centered absorption and Tb emission; addition of VMA rapidly enhances the 545 nm emission (response within 10 s), enabling quantitative detection in CH3CN, fetal calf serum and simulated urine and a qualitative dark-green response on test strips. Enhancement is attributed to antenna energy transfer from VMA to Tb(III). No magnetic data are reported.
